colorReference.method: Median RGB of a 3x3 screenshot patch; white uses #ffffff. Representative visible colors, not a claim to recover pre-compositing colors.

renderContract: Use drawing.version=1 to reproduce the reviewed vector preview. Legacy components/wires alone do not describe the detailed glyphs.
